title: Previous Permutation With One Swap
description: Find the lexicographically largest permutation that is smaller than the given array by swapping exactly one pair of elements.
pseudocode:
1. for i = n-2 down to 0:
2.   if arr[i] > arr[i+1]:
3.     for j = n-1 down to i+1:
4.       if arr[j] < arr[i] and arr[j] != arr[j-1]:
5.         swap(arr[i], arr[j])
6.         return arr

steps.note: Initialize array [3, 2, 1]. Start scanning from the second-to-last element.
Compare arr[1] (2) and arr[2] (1). 2 > 1 is true, found the pivot point.
Search for the largest element smaller than arr[i] (2) starting from the end.
arr[2] (1) is less than arr[1] (2). Condition satisfied.
